ideas.pitch: Real-time AR indoor and outdoor campus navigation for Rajarajeswari College of Engineering visitors to locate event halls, labs, and administrative offices without GPS drift.
ideas.title: CampusNav-AR
ideas.why_it_could_win: Faculty and industry judges from the host college will immediately appreciate a utility built specifically to solve navigation confusion during large events on their own campus.

ideas.pitch: Automated equipment booking, hardware inventory tracking, and usage prediction system for college engineering labs to prevent resource bottlenecks.
ideas.title: LabQueue-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Internal faculty judges deal with lab management inefficiencies daily and will value an open-innovation solution that directly targets campus infrastructure pain points.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined mid-event judging and team milestone tracker built specifically for hackathons to automate evaluation rubrics and time-keeping across multiple panels.
ideas.title: EvalSync-Open
ideas.why_it_could_win: Organizers and faculty running Celestia will instantly recognize the practical utility of a dashboard that simplifies their multi-round judging process.

ideas.pitch: Open-data price discovery and logistics matching platform for local agricultural vendors around Bangalore to aggregate commodity rates without middlemen.
ideas.title: LocalMandi-PriceOracle
ideas.why_it_could_win: Open-innovation judges love projects addressing regional socio-economic challenges with working web apps that have clear, real-world applicability in Karnataka.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight triage web app for local community health camps that logs patient vitals, categorizes urgency using basic rules, and generates instant digital prescriptions.
ideas.title: CommuneHealth-Vitals
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates strong social impact combined with a clean, working CRUD interface that is straightforward to test live in front of the judging panel.
